theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → 0 < α → α < 1 → ∃ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ K R : ℝ, 0 ≤ K → 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (x₀ : Euclid m) (w : Euclid m → Euclid k) (F : Euclid m → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball x₀ R) → ContinuousOn F (ball x₀ R) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖w x‖ ≤ K) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖F x‖ ≤ ε₁ * ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ + K) → (∀ (x : Euclid m) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → closedBall x ρ ⊆ ball x₀ R → ∃ c : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k, ∫ z in ball x ρ, ‖F z - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε₁ * ∫ z in ball x ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ w z - ⨍ z' in ball x ρ, fderiv ℝ w z'‖ ^ 2 + K * ρ ^ (2 * α) * ∫ z in ball x ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ ^ 2 + K * ρ ^ ((m : ℝ) + 2 * α)) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball x₀ R → ∫ x in ball x₀ R, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in ball x₀ R, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (F x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ (R / 4), ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ (R / 4), ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ (R / 4), ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
